sourceLifecycleReview.note: All raw receipt stream hashes and exact raw baseline snapshots verified independently; only CRLF-to-LF changed. Final LF contract/lifecycle/compile/types passed. These are local source/mocked tests, not engine traversal.

positiveFindings: All six final matched PNGs inspected. After views show a continuous readable route spanning the previously empty gap.
Timber rails on woodland side transition into stone parapets on quarry side; open arches and broad piers make the overview read as an intentional bridge rather than the earlier thin ribbon.
Waymarker and cart bays preserve visible prop silhouettes; no road obstruction is visible in the compared gameplay cameras.
Palette transitions from woodland earth toward quarry grey.
remainingArtGaps: The causeway has clearer structural identity, but the broader scene still has empty surrounding void and no demonstrated terrain footings beneath piers.
Long road surface, repetitive clean stone blocks and sparse detail remain below high-fidelity environmental art quality.
Quarry context remains schematic block geometry; full native scene, NPCs, effects and endpoint integration are not represented by these Blender views.
Grass shoulders and decorative rail meshes are noncolliding; roadside bays and rails are not certified walkable surfaces or fall barriers.
